panels.burned_in_description: Printed header text on the film photograph includes a partly pixelated patient label block, a birth-date line and an examination date and time line, plus scanner parameter text.
panels.notes: Viewed pixels: MRI film with burned-in header identifiers (direct identifiers, not transcribed); no face or external sensitive anatomy; soft-tissue outline of the back is not a face.
